Inside the large circle, small text: '公开市场操作由纽约联储交易台执行'. Header above lower tier: '实际运行的集中结果'. Between the two tiers, a thin diagonal arrow pointing from the upper 12-circle arrangement down to the lower 1+11 arrangement, labeled '演变为' (evolved into, soft language — NOT 'overpowered' or 'controlled'). Background soft beige (#F5F2EB). Text color deep gray (#2C2C2C). No realistic human faces. No conspiratorial imagery. Aspect ratio 5:6 (portrait, mobile-friendly).
